idle: Exact Pebble identity, side profile facing left, idle guard, basalt, amber eyes/cracks, cyan rimlight, transparent alpha, no VFX or floor.

variants.attack: A strong horizontal forward punch toward the LEFT, front arm fully extended, torso leaning into punch, rear fist guarding. Keep feet planted.
variants.hit: Recoiling from a blow arriving from the LEFT: body leaning to the RIGHT, fists lifted defensively, knees absorbing impact. Clearly injured, no attack.
variants.critical: A powerful overhead downward hammer-fist strike toward the LEFT, front fist raised and descending, crouched forceful forward posture. Distinct from horizontal punch.
variants.dodge: A low nimble evasive lean BACK toward the RIGHT, crouched knees, fists held close and eyes watching LEFT. Clearly purposeful evasion, not injured.
variants.combo: A flowing follow-through wide sweeping stone fist strike toward the LEFT at waist height, torso rotated, rear heel raised. Distinct from normal straight punch.
variants.replay: A compact quick second attack toward the LEFT: low forward step, tight rising stone uppercut, other fist pulled back. Distinct from wide sweep and straight punch.

constraints: One full-body sprite per call. Same anatomy/scale/pelvis, feet about 91% height, actual transparent alpha, no text/UI/background/shadow/effects. Variants edit the generated idle.
